Jordan’s first nomination. He took on a unique double role in “Sinners,” portraying twins named Elijah “Smoke” Moore and Elias “Stack” Moore. He’s already added to his award case for the role, winning Best Actor at the Screen Actors Guild (SAG) Awards.Timothee ChalametTo Win: Yes 3.22x | No 1.35xTimothee Chalamet is no stranger to a Best Actor nomination, as he fell short for the award in 2025 for “A Complete Unknown” and in 2018 for “Call Me by Your Name.” This time Chalamet is a nominee for his colorful portrayal of Marty Reisman, a larger-than-life American table tennis player, in “Marty Supreme.” His performance already earned a 2026 Golden Globe for Best Actor in a Musical or Comedy Film.The 30-year-old star made history as the youngest male actor to earn three Best Actor nominations since Marlon Brando in 1954. But he’s still chasing sweet victory. Will Chalamet finally win Best Actor at the Academy Awards?2026 Oscars Best Actor Prediction Here is our Best Actor prediction for the 2026 Oscars. To get real-money action and earn real money on your Oscars, head over to PrizePicks Culture Picks — available in 48 states.Leonardo DiCaprio in “One Battle After Another,” Wagner Moura in “The Secret Agent,” and Ethan Hawke in “Blue Moon” are all worthy nominees, although Jessie Plemons in “Bugonia” still feels like a snub. With that said, this may come down to Chalamet or Jordan.Previous award shows can be a good way to assess what’s to come, and Jordan won Best Actor at the Actor Awards — formerly known as the SAG Awards. Neither actor won the BAFTA Award, with Robert Aramayo reigning supreme thanks to his role in “I Swear,” which will be eligible for the 2027 Oscars.Jordan could have the best argument with “Sinners” carrying the second-lowest payout to win Best Picture at the 2026 Oscars (4.54x), per PrizePicks Culture Picks. “Marty Supreme” also received a nomination for Best Picture but carries a 33.33x payout to win the award. “Sinners” is beyond just Best Picture, setting an all-time Oscars record with 16 nominations, including Delroy Lindo for Best Supporting Actor.
